answer: SELECT r.yr AS race_year, r.event_schedule->>'event_name' AS event_name, (d.driver_identity->'name'->>'first_name') || ' ' || (d.driver_identity->'name'->>'surname') AS driver_name, ds.px AS podium_position, FLOOR(((r.event_schedule->>'date_set')::date - (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date) / 365.25)::int AS age_at_race FROM driver_standings ds JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = ds.rlink JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = ds.drive_link WHERE ds.px BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND FLOOR(((r.event_schedule->>'date_set')::date - (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date) / 365.25) >= 35 ORDER BY age_at_race DESC, race_year DESC
note: No main-race results table exists; used driver_standings.px (rank 1-3) as the podium position. Sprint results would give only 4 Hamilton rows instead.

answer: WITH rel AS (SELECT cr.unitnode, COUNT(*) AS starts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.st_mark IS NULL) AS finishes FROM constructor_results cr GROUP BY cr.unitnode HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) SELECT ROUND(MAX(100.0 * finishes / starts), 2) AS max_reliability_rate FROM rel

WITH rel AS (SELECT c.cstr_key, c.namelabel, COUNT(*) AS races_started, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE cr.st_mark IS NULL) AS races_finished FROM constructor_results cr JOIN constructors c ON c.cstr_key = cr.unitnode GROUP BY c.cstr_key, c.namelabel HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) SELECT namelabel AS constructor_name, races_started, races_finished, ROUND(100.0 * races_finished / races_started, 2) AS reliability_rate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY 100.0 * races_finished / races_started DESC) AS reliability_rank FROM rel ORDER BY reliability_rate DESC

WITH per_race AS (SELECT wheel_unit, rc_index, STDDEV_POP(msec_val / 1000.0) AS ltc FROM lap_times WHERE msec_val IS NOT NULL GROUP BY wheel_unit, rc_index) SELECT jsonb_build_object('surname', d.driver_identity->'name'->>'surname', 'first_name', d.driver_identity->'name'->>'first_name') AS driver_name, AVG(p.ltc) AS avg_consistency, COUNT(*) AS races_analyzed FROM per_race p JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = p.wheel_unit GROUP BY d.drv_main, d.driver_identity HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY avg_consistency ASC

WITH ham AS (SELECT ds.rlink, ds.acc_pt, (r.event_schedule->>'date_set')::date AS race_date, d.driver_identity->>'birth_date' AS birth_date FROM driver_standings ds JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = ds.drive_link JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = ds.rlink WHERE d.driver_identity->>'reference' = 'hamilton'), ppr AS (SELECT rlink, race_date, birth_date, acc_pt / COUNT(*) OVER (ORDER BY race_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ppr FROM ham) SELECT rlink AS race_id, ppr / FLOOR((CURRENT_DATE - birth_date::date) / 365.25) AS dpv FROM ppr ORDER BY race_date
note: PPR taken as the season-cumulative acc_pt divided by a running count of Hamilton's standings rows; Driver Age uses the current date per the knowledge definition.

answer: SELECT ROUND(AVG(0.35 * 0.25), 4) AS avg_hat_trick_probability FROM qualifying WHERE px_pos = 1
SELECT MIN(msec_val) / 1000.0 AS fastest_lap_seconds FROM lap_times WHERE msec_val > 0

WITH s AS (SELECT matchidx, COUNT(*)::numeric / COUNT(DISTINCT wunit) AS avg_stops_per_car FROM pit_stops GROUP BY matchidx) SELECT COUNT(*) AS single_stop_race_count FROM s WHERE avg_stops_per_car < 1.5

WITH w AS (SELECT matchref, (sprint_performance->'timing'->>'duration_ms')::bigint AS ms FROM sprint_results WHERE (sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 1), s AS (SELECT matchref, (sprint_performance->'timing'->>'duration_ms')::bigint AS ms FROM sprint_results WHERE (sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 2) SELECT COUNT(*) AS dominant_victory_count FROM w JOIN s ON s.matchref = w.matchref WHERE (s.ms - w.ms) / 1000.0 > 5

SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE((r.event_schedule->>'date_set')::date, (d.driver_identity->>'birth_date')::date))) AS avg_sprint_winner_age FROM sprint_results s JOIN races r ON r.rak_id = s.matchref JOIN drivers d ON d.drv_main = s.unitdrive WHERE (s.sprint_performance->>'final_position')::int = 1 AND d.driver_identity->>'birth_date' IS NOT NULL
